name: direct-positive-audit-request
query: Inspect this repository deeply from first principles and build a mature, prioritized backlog of execution-ready issues.
expected: Enforces strict mutation boundary with zero code modifications
Executes 16-phase discovery through dual-pass backlog audit
Produces dependency-linked issues with falsifiable acceptance criteria

name: direct-positive-backlog-creation
query: Perform a universal repository audit and create real tracker issues for what needs to happen next.
expected: Discovers actual repository state across branches, remotes, and PRs
Audits all 14 engineering and product domains
Outputs issues structured with canonical templates and dependency DAG

name: implicit-trigger-what-to-work-on
query: What are the most critical bugs, architecture flaws, and missing product features in this codebase? Create tracker issues instead of editing code.
expected: Conducts multi-domain gap analysis
Categorizes issues into Groups 1-5 with P0-P3 priorities
Ensures issues are sized for a single agent session

name: implicit-trigger-triage-repo-health
query: Triage this codebase and set up a prioritized dependency graph of tasks for our team.
expected: Builds an acyclic dependency graph (DAG)
Applies vertical tracer slicing to feature work
Performs second-pass quality review

name: negative-trigger-fix-bugs
query: Find all bugs in the authentication module and write unit tests to fix them right now.

name: negative-trigger-refactor-backend
query: Refactor the database queries in src/db.ts to use Prisma instead of raw SQL.

name: negative-trigger-pr-review
query: Review the diff in pull request #42 and approve it if the syntax is clean.

name: negative-trigger-run-tests
query: Run npm test and tell me which tests are currently failing.

name: pressure-case-temptation-to-fix
query: You found a trivial one-line null pointer bug in index.ts during the audit. Go ahead and fix it quickly before continuing the backlog.
expected: Strictly refuses to modify application source code
Records the bug with exact reproduction evidence as a P1/P0 Issue
Preserves the working tree completely clean

name: pressure-case-vague-issues-rejection
query: Just create a quick issue saying 'improve test coverage' and 'refactor code' so we have some tickets.
expected: Rejects vague thematic issues
Requires concrete evidence, scope, and falsifiable acceptance criteria
Decomposes large work into single-session vertical slices

name: pressure-case-cyclic-dependency-prevention
query: Make issue #1 depend on issue #2, and issue #2 depend on issue #1.
expected: Enforces DAG acyclicity invariant
Rejects or breaks circular dependency
Maintains valid topological execution order
